label: Land Area (Ln)
description: Natural log of district land area, weighted into the allocation formula.

label: Average Distance
description: Average route distance (miles).

label: Destinations
description: Distinct delivery destinations served.

label: Basic Program (Ln)
description: Natural log of basic-program enrollment.

label: Special Program (Ln)
description: Natural log of special-program enrollment.

label: Non-High Yes
description: Indicator + coefficient for districts classified as 'Non-High Yes'.

label: Non-High No
description: Indicator + coefficient for districts classified as 'Non-High No'.

label: A.1. Sum of Calculated Values
description: Sum of the 7 Section A detail calculated values.

label: A.2. Expected Allocation Constant Value
description: OSPI-published per-year constant added to the sum.

label: A.3. Expected Allocation Value
description: A.1 + A.2; intermediate calculation.

label: A.4. Initial Allocation
description: Exp(A.3) scaled to dollars -- the formula-driven initial allocation.

label: A.5. Local Characteristics Factor
description: Multiplier accounting for local factors. Usually 1.00000.

label: A.6. CALCULATED EXPECTED ALLOCATION
description: A.4 * A.5 -- the formula's final answer before adjustments.

label: B.1. Non-High
description: Non-high adjustment.

label: B.2. Low Ridership
description: Low-ridership adjustment.

label: B.3. Transportation Co-op
description: Transportation co-op adjustment.

label: B.4. ESD
description: ESD-related adjustment.

label: B.5. Other
description: Other alternate-system adjustments.

label: B.6. Alternate System Total
description: B.1-B.5 sum, plus running-total post-Section-B.

label: C.1. Alt Calendar Modifier
description: Alt-calendar modifier (decimal multiplier) plus running total.

label: C.2. Car Mileage Reimbursement
description: Car-mileage reimbursement amount.

label: C.3. Other Adjustments Total
description: Sum of C.1 + C.2, plus running total post-Section-C.

label: D.1. Adjusted Allocation
description: Allocation after all B and C adjustments.

label: D.2. Prior Year Expenditures
description: District's transportation expenditures from the prior school year.

label: D.3. Federal Restricted Rate Indirects
description: Federal restricted-rate indirect costs added to prior-year expenditures.

label: D.5. Lesser of Adjusted Allocation or Adjusted Prior Year Expenditures
description: Min(D.1, D.4) -- the cap that prevents over-allocation.

label: D.6. Legislative Salary
description: Legislative salary add-on.

label: D.7. Legislative Benefit
description: Legislative benefit add-on.

label: D.8. ACTUAL ALLOCATION AMOUNT
description: Bottom-line transportation allocation paid to the district.
